name: leaderboard
title: Leaderboard
description: Ranked people or teams with avatars, score bars, gold, silver and bronze badges and place changes. Sorted for you; bars fill in on scroll.
htmlExample:
<bef-leaderboard class="w-[30rem] max-w-full" :items='[{"name":"Rohan Das","subtitle":"Enterprise","value":2450000,"delta":2},{"name":"Diya Rao","subtitle":"Mid-market","value":3120000,"delta":-1},{"name":"Isha Nair","subtitle":"Enterprise","value":2980000,"delta":1},{"name":"Kabir Shah","subtitle":"SMB","value":1620000,"delta":0},{"name":"Ananya Kulkarni","subtitle":"SMB","value":1240000,"delta":-2}]' id="g1"></bef-leaderboard>
<script type="module">
document.getElementById("g1").props = {
  format: (n) => `₹${(n / 1e5).toFixed(1)}L`,
};
</script>
